name: tobi-portfolio-tests
description: Test harness for tobi.getpolisha.com. Lives outside the deployed site (see ../.vercelignore) so the site stays a zero-dependency static project. `npm test` drives the real site in a real browser at every supported width; `npm run test:api` exercises api/contact.js directly with a stubbed fetch, so the consent branches are checked without ever calling Resend. `npm run test:audit` covers the Workflow Audit arithmetic and endpoint; `npm run test:audit-page` drives the twelve-step flow in a browser.
